Class TuiController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.client.controller.ClientController
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.client.view.tui.TuiController
public class TuiController extends ClientController
TUI-specific input handler that reads commands from standard input and dispatches them to the appropriate ClientController actions.

Owns the main read-dispatch loop (run()) and translates raw text tokens into typed method calls on the parent controller. The class also stores the connection parameters (networkType, host, port) needed to rebuild the server proxy after a disconnection.

MVC layer: View — pure input handling; no rendering logic.

      public TuiController(ServerProxy proxy, LobbyModel lobbyModel, ClientView view, NetworkType networkType, String host, int port)
      Creates a TuiController bound to the given proxy, models, and view.
      Parameters:
      proxy - the server-communication proxy
      lobbyModel - shared client-side lobby state
      view - the TUI view that will render output; must be a TuiView
      networkType - the transport technology chosen at startup
      host - server hostname or IP address
      port - server port number

  • Method Details

    • run

      public void run()
      Starts the blocking input loop, reading one line at a time from standard input and forwarding each non-empty line to dispatch(String).

      Runs on the calling thread; designed to be invoked from the application main thread after all components have been wired up.

    • createNewProxy

      protected ServerProxy createNewProxy() throws Exception
      Creates a fresh ServerProxy of the same transport type as the one currently in use. Called internally during lobby return and reconnection.

      Rebuilds the server proxy using the connection parameters supplied at construction time, enabling transparent reconnection after a network fault.

      Specified by:
      createNewProxy in class ClientController
      Returns:
      a new, unconnected proxy
      Throws:
      Exception - if the proxy cannot be constructed (e.g. invalid host/port)
